name: Miscellaneous Stainless & Steel Works LLC (MSSW LLC)
old_description: Providing fabrication and installation services for Stainless Steel, Aluminum, and Mild Steel applications.
about:
Miscellaneous Stainless & Steel Works LLC (MSSW) was founded in 2004 in Durham, North Carolina. The company is owner‑operated and specializes in custom metal fabrication and installation for commercial, industrial, and retail projects across the state.

The shop works with stainless steel, aluminum, and mild steel, offering welding (TIG and MIG), clean‑edge finishing, CAD‑driven design, and on‑site installation. Every team member is an AWS‑certified welder, and the crew handles projects from initial site measurement through final fitting, including repairs and retrofits.

MSSW serves retail and restaurant chains, industrial and utility clients, healthcare and laboratory facilities, and general contractors. Past work includes air‑handling platforms at NC State University, custom countertops for BurgerFi, architectural steel frames at Lynnhaven Mall, bumper rails for Chapel Hill Hospital, and a full kitchen fabrication for a Chapel Hill deli.

The company emphasizes durability and integrity, describing its work as “engineered, inspected, and installed with care.” It positions itself on fast turnaround, code‑compliant results, and a field‑tested, inspector‑ready approach that aims to get the job right the first time.
